response.text: Buy Vendor B: first-year cost is $18,500 ( $14,000 + $3,000 + $1,500 onboarding) vs Vendor A’s $18,000, but B’s ongoing annual cost is $17,000 vs A’s $18,000, so you break even after about 18 months and save $1,000 every year thereafter—pick B if you expect to keep the service beyond ~1.5 years; pick A only if you need it for a single year or want no upfront onboarding fee.
